tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Everything 1211 prints on: each item's colours, sizes, print sizes, the pixels a picture needs to print well, and its price including US shipping.

item.description: Optional: one item (for example "hoodie") to get just that one.

tools.name: check_art
tools.description: Fetches a picture from a public link, or takes an attached file, stores it for a design and reports its size in pixels and how big it prints well. PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, HEIC, PDF or SVG, up to 25 MB. Pictures that are never ordered are deleted after 30 days.

image_url.description: A public http(s) link to the picture.

file.description: A file the person attached in the conversation, as an object with file_id and/or download_url.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Puts a picture (a public link, an upload id, an attached file or SVG markup) on an item and colour and returns the page where the person sees it, picks sizes and pays, with a picture of the result, how big each side prints, the price including US shipping, and any problems. With no picture, it returns the page where the person adds their own picture to the item. A shirt's front prints small on the left chest or big and centered; backs print large. No payment passes through this tool: the person pays on the returned page. Printing requires that the person owns the art or has permission to print it. Limit: 30 designs per address per hour.

image_url.description: A public http(s) link to the picture.

file.description: A file the person attached in the conversation, as an object with file_id and/or download_url.

upload.description: An upload id, instead of image_url.

svg.description: SVG markup (lettering or simple shapes) with a viewBox; scripts and linked files are removed. Fonts available: Lato, DejaVu Sans, DejaVu Serif, Liberation Sans, Liberation Serif, Nimbus Sans, URW Gothic, URW Bookman, C059, P052, Z003, Noto Color Emoji.

color.description: One of the item's colours; left out, its default.

front.description: chest: small on the left chest (default). center: big and centered, on T-shirts, sweatshirts and hoodies.

size.description: A size to start with on the page, such as "L".

back_image_url.description: A different picture for the back.

title.description: A name for the design (80 characters).

ref.description: The name of the assistant or app, such as "claude".

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: A saved design: its page link, pictures, print sizes and price.

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description: Stores a report about something wrong with 1211's results (a picture refused that should have printed, a wrong price, a picture of the result that does not match, a link that does not open, a failed checkout, or a missing item) with the design it concerns and a short description. A person reads every report. Limit: 20 per address per hour.

design.description: The design id, when it is about one design.

detail.description: What was wrong, in a sentence or two.
